title: Add AI Homework Solver to learn
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [AI Homework Solver](https://zizoisu.github.io/ai-homework-solver) to learn
- A web-based homework solver that integrates with Pollinations AI. Supports multiple question types including MCQ, short answer, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions. Features a hybrid model wit

Fixes #14310

gist.headline: Homework gets a study buddy
gist.blurb: AI Homework Solver has joined the learn garden. It helps turn multiple-choice, short-answer, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions into something a little less mysterious.
gist.summary: Added AI Homework Solver to the learn collection, a Pollinations-powered web app for working through MCQ, short-answer, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank homework questions with a hybrid model approach.
gist.impact: Learners can now find a dedicated Pollinations-powered homework helper in learn for several common question formats.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy after-school study nook with a retro computer showing several simple quiz cards—multiple choice, true/false, and a fill-in-the-blank—alongside sprouting code-plants and small flowers. Polli, wearing tiny round teacher glasses and carrying a pencil, warmly helps organize the questions while a friendly CRT monitor robot displays a solved answer card.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art study nook where the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny teacher glasses and holds a pencil while helping a chunky CRT monitor robot sort MCQ, true/false, short-answer, and fill-in-the-blank quiz cards beside flowering code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle pixel-font text: "LEARN".
